data.summary:
Full-Stack Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience building scalable SaaS applications using React, Redux, Tailwind, FastAPI, Django, Flask, and Spring Boot.
Skilled in designing modern APIs, cloud-native backend systems, and data-intensive pipelines across AWS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ.
Delivered AI-powered RAG search, optimized API performance, automated CI/CD, and built multi-tenant platforms in Agile environments.

responsibilities: Led the launch of a cloud-based SaaS platform with 300+ MAUs in 5 months, implementing PostgreSQL multi-tenancy to enable 5 state departments and increase adoption 5x.

Refactored front-end with React, Redux, Tailwind, optimized FastAPI APIs with Redis (reducing latency by 3s), developed RAG-based GPT-4/LangChain search for 450+ PDFs, and automated 600+ unit tests via GitLab CI.
Automated data migrations via Airflow, standardizing deployments and accelerating release cycles.
Contributed to GCP migration PoCs (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, IAM) and assisted in building prototype dashboards using
Built Django REST APIs and data models for 700K+ responses, enabling nationwide telecom analysis.
Centralized multi-department data into SQL Server powering 25 Tableau dashboards, implemented Redis middleware for API idempotency, and integrated ELK stack for auditability and real-time monitoring.
Maintained data provenance using SQL Server triggers and audit tables for complete historical tracking.
Supported automation of data migrations via Airflow, standardizing workflows and reducing manual effort

projects.name: Heart Disease Prediction
projects.description: Developed a heart disease prediction model using XG-Boost and SVM algorithms on a dataset of 300+ medical records. – Achieved 99% recall and 97% accuracy , identifying high-risk patients with minimal false negatives. – Deployed the model using Flask with an interactive JavaScript frontend, handling 100+ real-time predictions/day

projects.name: Phishield Mails
projects.description: Architected a secure email management system using APIs, enhancing efficiency and reducing API latency by 30%. – Developed and deployed an AI-driven email classifier, reducing manual email sorting efforts by 45% and enhancing phishing detection accuracy. Optimized a React-based web app interface, processing 100+ mails simultaneously, boosting engagement by 25% through an enhanced user experience. Built an Angular prototype of an email analytics dashboard to explore component architecture, routing, and service-based API integration for future migration.

projects.name: Al Job Tracker
projects.description: Developed a HATEOAS-compliant REST API for astronomers to record and share observations. – Deployed a fault-tolerant AWS ECS system,implemented caching and asynchronous email alerts to improve performance. – Leveraged Redis and RabbitMQ for optimized caching and messaging, ensuring smooth scaling and reliability. – Built cloud-native PoC on GCP to deploy microservice and evaluate portability, scaling, security, and cost.

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
Projects
Heart Disease Prediction
Developed a heart disease prediction model using XG-Boost and SVM algorithms on a dataset of 300+ medical records. – Achieved 99% recall and 97% accuracy , identifying high-risk patients with minimal false negatives. – Deployed the model using Flask with an interactive JavaScript frontend, handling 100+ real-time predictions/day – Tech Stack: Machine Learning, Python, Flask, JavaScript
Phishield Mails
Architected a secure email management system using APIs, enhancing efficiency and reducing API latency by 30%. – Developed and deployed an AI-driven email classifier, reducing manual email sorting efforts by 45% and enhancing phishing detection accuracy.
Optimized a React-based web app interface, processing 100+ mails simultaneously, boosting engagement by 25% through an enhanced user experience.
Built an Angular prototype of an email analytics dashboard to explore component architecture, routing, and service-based API integration for future migration.
Tech Stack: ReactJS, JavaScript, CSS, Generative AI, Google Auth, Web Analytics
Al Job Tracker
Developed a HATEOAS-compliant REST API for astronomers to record and share observations. – Deployed a fault-tolerant AWS ECS system,implemented caching and asynchronous email alerts to improve performance.
– Leveraged Redis and RabbitMQ for optimized caching and messaging, ensuring smooth scaling and reliability. – Built cloud-native PoC on GCP to deploy microservice and evaluate portability, scaling, security, and cost. – Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ
